name: aronda Filter Gallery – Filter, Structure & Gallery for Elementor
author: arondadigital

sections.description:
aronda Filter Gallery – Filter, Structure & Gallery for Elementor

The aronda Filter Gallery extends Elementor with a powerful filter and gallery function. Present your content in a structured way and allow visitors to quickly find content via categories or search terms – ideal for portfolios, references, products, events, image galleries or blog posts.
Filtering works without page reload, so content is displayed instantly and usability is significantly improved.

  • Intuitive filter function
    Enable targeted navigation through your content – without reloading the page.

  • Search engine friendly & accessible
    Thanks to semantic markup and accessible code, your website remains easy to read not only for users but also for Google.

  • Optimized for performance
    Fast loading times and a resource-saving “Load More” mechanism ensure a smooth user experience – even with many items.

  • Individually customizable
    Adjust layout, colors, spacing and effects to match your design – directly in the Elementor editor, without programming knowledge.

The Filter Gallery integrates seamlessly into your existing web design and makes it easy for visitors to discover content in a structured way.

Key Features

  • Filter by categories
    Content can be structured and displayed using filter buttons. Visitors can sort content by categories or individual filter terms.

  • Load More function
    Large amounts of content can be loaded step by step using a “Load More” button. This improves performance and loading times.

  • Elementor integration
    The Filter Gallery is fully integrated into Elementor and can be used like any other widget – without programming.

  • Individual layout and design customization
    Colors, spacing, columns, hover effects, navigation, icons and layout can be adjusted directly in the Elementor editor.

  • Responsive design
    The Filter Gallery works on desktop, tablet and smartphone and can be customized individually.

Use Cases

The Filter Gallery is particularly suitable for:

  • Portfolios
  • References
  • Product overviews
  • Image galleries
  • Blog posts
  • Projects
  • Real estate
  • Events
  • Case studies

Works perfectly with the Elementor Website Builder

The plugin was specifically developed for Elementor and integrates fully into the editor.
All settings can be configured directly in the Elementor panel – layout, filters, gallery, navigation, colors and spacing.

Free Version Features

The free version already includes:

  • Filter function
  • Grid layout
  • Elementor widget
  • Responsive settings
  • Basic design customization
  • Performance optimized display
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through the WordPress Plugins > Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor.
  4. Add the aronda Filter Gallery widget to your layout.
  5. Configure the gallery and filter settings in the Elementor panel.
sections.faq:
What does the Filter Gallery do?

The aronda Filter Gallery is an Elementor widget that allows content such as projects, images, references, products or posts to be filtered by categories or topics. Visitors can quickly find content using filter buttons without reloading the page.

Does the plugin only work with Elementor?

Yes, the Filter Gallery is an add-on for Elementor and can only be used if Elementor is installed and activated.

Is the content filtered without page reload?

Filtering works dynamically without reloading the page. This improves usability and performance.

Is there a “Load More” function?

Yes. If many items are available, they can be loaded step by step using a “Load More” button. This keeps loading times short and the page clear. These settings can also be adjusted responsively depending on screen size.

Can I customize the design of the Filter Gallery?

Colors, spacing, columns, layout, hover effects, navigation and other design options can be adjusted directly in the Elementor editor so the gallery can fit into almost any existing website design.

Is the Filter Gallery responsive?

Yes. The Filter Gallery works on desktop, tablet and smartphone. Columns and layout can be adjusted for different devices.

Is the plugin SEO-friendly?

The Filter Gallery uses clean code and structured content output so search engines can read the content easily.

Does the plugin work with many items?

Thanks to the Load More function and optimized loading, the Filter Gallery is also suitable for large amounts of content.

Do I need programming knowledge?

No. All settings can be configured directly in the Elementor editor.
